name: Mobility Resort Motegi (road course)
coordinates: x east, z south, y up; meters
bank_convention: Positive bank raises the geometric left road edge relative to center

metadata.layout: Full road course (4.801 km), clockwise, passing under the oval through the tunnel (OSM way 28213530); not the oval and not the east/west short courses

start_finish.source: Start line: the full-width transverse white line on the main straight just before the start gantry, with faint grid-slot marks behind it, identified in the GSI seamlessphoto (zoom 18) orthoimage

width.status: Published width; fewer than 40% of imagery edge measurements were plausible
